data.body: Follow-up to PS-index-cap (bug Bece55b8a77). The index is keyed on SCHEMA/FOLD_REV, so a fold or handler edit without a FOLD_REV bump silently reuses a stale index. Record a hash of the fold/handler source tree (ddflow/core fold and handlers) next to FOLD_REV and add a test that fails when the hash differs from the recorded one, telling the author to bump FOLD_REV and update the recorded hash. Regression test must fail against a tree where a fold file changed without the bump. Keep merge-conflict surface small (one recorded line).
data.title: Guard the FOLD_REV hazard: a test fails when fold/handler sources change without a FOLD_REV bump
